description: Dependency updates: weekly on Monday, every non-major update in one pull request, each major update on its own, Playwright and its container image together, Node.js and the worker image's base image together, security updates at any time.

packageRules.description: Every update that is not a new major version goes into one pull request.
Dependencies the application runs with are fixes; development dependencies, actions, Node.js, pnpm, tools and container digests stay chores.
npm packages are updated only after they have been public for a few days.
Node.js moves only to LTS major versions, which are the even ones, both in .nvmrc and in the base image of worker.Dockerfile.
The Node.js types follow the Node.js major version.

description: The Playwright packages and the end-to-end container image move together in one pull request for every update type, because scripts/test-e2e.ts fails when their versions differ. This rule comes after the non-major group, so it wins over it.

The group waits as long as other npm packages do. The image's registry publishes no release dates, so the image is not aged itself (timestamp-optional) and the packages' age holds the whole group: no update is dropped from the group while it waits (internalChecksFilter none), and the branch is created only once every aged update has passed (prCreation not-pending).

packageRules.description: Node.js in .nvmrc and the base image of worker.Dockerfile, which Renovate's dockerfile manager finds by its .Dockerfile suffix, move together in one pull request for every update type, because a unit test fails when their versions differ. This rule comes after the non-major group, so it wins over it.

customManagers.description: The Playwright container image, tag and digest, in scripts/test-e2e.ts.

Tool versions in workflows, actions and Taskfile.yml written under a `# renovate: datasource=<datasource> depName=<name>` comment, such as Task, gitleaks, actionlint, zizmor, the Vercel CLI and the Neon CLI.
